name: js-neurominds-v1
description: JS Neurominds and Diagnostic Center — V1 production monorepo. Public website + Admin CMS + Google Apps Script backend. Built by TCGR Technologies (tcgr.in).

scripts.validate: node scripts/build-content-index.js && node scripts/validate-schemas.js && node scripts/validate-seed.js
scripts.build: node scripts/build-content-index.js && node scripts/clean-dist.js && node scripts/build-stubs.js && vite build --config vite.public.config.js && node scripts/copy-static.js
scripts.build:admin: node scripts/build-content-index.js && vite build --config vite.admin.config.js && node scripts/copy-static.js admin
scripts.prod:public: npm run build && vite preview --config vite.public.config.js --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
scripts.prod:admin: npm run build:admin && vite preview --config vite.admin.config.js --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8081

author: TCGR Technologies (tcgr.in)
